title: Checking Account Minimum Opening Deposit
text: The consumer checking account onboarding service must require an initial opening deposit of at least $25.00 via verified debit card or ACH transfer. Opening requests with an initial deposit under $25.00 must be declined immediately with an error message.
acceptance_criteria: Given an applicant completing checking account opening, when deposit >= $25.00, account opens in Active state; when deposit < $25.00, system blocks submission with code ERR_MIN_DEPOSIT.

title: Monthly Maintenance Fee Waiver Criteria
text: The monthly maintenance fee of $12.00 must be waived for accounts that maintain an average daily balance of at least $1,500.00 or receive cumulative qualifying direct deposits of at least $500.00 during the statement cycle. If neither condition is met, assess exactly $12.00 at statement cutoff.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account cycle cutoff, when avg balance >= $1500 or direct deposits >= $500, fee is $0.00; otherwise $12.00 is debited with transaction code MTH_FEE.

title: Overdraft Protection and Fee Threshold
text: When an enrolled account incurs a debit that reduces the available balance below $0.00 by more than $5.00, assess an overdraft fee of $35.00. Do not assess an overdraft fee if the resulting negative balance is $5.00 or less, or if the customer has not opted into overdraft coverage. A maximum of 3 overdraft fees may be assessed per calendar day.
acceptance_criteria: Given negative balance transaction, when opt-in is active and overdrawn by >$5.00, assess $35.00 up to daily limit of 3; when overdrawn <=$5.00 or opt-out, fee is $0.00.

title: Tiered High-Yield Savings Interest Accrual
text: The savings ledger must calculate interest daily based on the end-of-day available balance. Tier 1 balances up to $9,999.99 earn 1.50% APY; Tier 2 balances from $10,000.00 to $49,999.99 earn 3.25% APY; Tier 3 balances of $50,000.00 and above earn 4.50% APY. Daily interest must round to the nearest cent using half-up arithmetic.
acceptance_criteria: Given end-of-day balance, apply exact tier APY / 365, accumulate accrued interest, and compound to principal on the final calendar day of each month.

title: Domestic Wire Transfer Daily Limit & Dual Authorization
text: Domestic outbound wire transfers must enforce a maximum single transfer limit of $100,000.00 and a daily cumulative customer limit of $250,000.00. Any single wire transfer exceeding $25,000.00 requires secondary dual authorization from an authorized banking compliance officer prior to execution.
acceptance_criteria: Given outbound wire request, when amount > $100,000 or daily total > $250,000, reject request; when amount > $25,000 and <= $100,000, place in Pending_Officer_Review state; when <= $25,000, process automatically.

title: Personal Loan Debt-To-Income (DTI) Hard Cap
text: Unsecured personal loan applicants must have a verified monthly Debt-To-Income (DTI) ratio of no more than 43.0% including the prospective loan monthly payment. Applications with DTI exceeding 43.0% must be declined automatically with adverse action notice code DTI_EXCEEDED.
acceptance_criteria: Given personal loan application, calculate total monthly obligations divided by gross monthly income; if ratio <= 43.0%, proceed to credit tiering; if ratio > 43.0%, decline with adverse action record.

title: Personal Loan Credit Score Tiering and Maximum Amount
text: Loan underwriting must tier credit limits by FICO score: Tier A (FICO >= 740) allows loan amounts up to $50,000.00; Tier B (FICO 680 to 739) allows loan amounts up to $25,000.00; Tier C (FICO 620 to 679) allows loan amounts up to $10,000.00. Applicants with FICO below 620 must be declined automatically.
acceptance_criteria: Given verified FICO score and requested loan amount, approve if requested amount <= tier limit; counter-offer if requested amount > tier limit but applicant qualifies for tier cap; decline if FICO < 620.

title: Customer KYC Identity Document Validity Check
text: The customer onboarding service must verify that government-issued photo identification (Passport, Driver License, or National ID) is unexpired at the time of application submission. If the document expiration date is on or before the application date, the application must be blocked with KYC_EXPIRED_ID.
acceptance_criteria: Given uploaded applicant identity document, compare expiration date against system current date; when expiration date > current date, proceed; when expiration date <= current date, block submission.

title: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Cash Transaction Reporting (CTR)
text: Any cash deposit, cash withdrawal, or exchange of currency exceeding $10,000.00 conducted by or on behalf of one individual in a single business day must automatically trigger a FinCEN Form 112 Currency Transaction Report (CTR) filing record within the compliance ledger.
acceptance_criteria: Given cash transactions in a calendar day, aggregate total currency; when aggregate cash > $10,000.00, generate CTR filing event with timestamp, teller ID, and customer tax ID.

title: ATM Daily Cash Withdrawal Limit
text: Consumer debit cards must enforce a 24-hour rolling cash withdrawal limit of $1,000.00 at automated teller machines (ATMs). Cumulative ATM withdrawals exceeding $1,000.00 within a 24-hour window must be declined with ATM response code 61 (Exceeds withdrawal amount limit).
acceptance_criteria: Given ATM cash withdrawal authorization request, calculate sum of completed withdrawals in past 24 hours + requested amount; if sum <= $1,000.00, approve; if sum > $1,000.00, decline with code 61.
